title: Protocol for examining and eliminating base editor-induced genome-wide and transcriptome-wide off-target mutations
protocol: Amplify the gRNA sequences by PCR.
Add oligonucleotides (pUC57-sgRNA-MS2-U6) to the reaction mixture.
Add 10 μM F primer to the reaction mixture.
Add 10 μM R primer to the reaction mixture.
Add PrimeSTAR Buffer (5×) to the reaction mixture.
Add dNTP Mix (2.5 mM) to the reaction mixture.
Add PrimeSTAR® HS DNA Polymerase to the reaction mixture.
Add H₂O to reach a total volume of 50 μl.
Initiate PCR at 94 ℃ for 5 minutes.
Cycle through 35 cycles: 98 ℃ for 15 seconds, 68 ℃ for 15 seconds, and 72 ℃ for 30 seconds.
Final extension at 72 ℃ for 3 minutes.
Purify amplified DNA fragments using a 2% agarose gel.
Measure the concentration of purified DNA fragments by Nanodrop.
Digest the gRNA-tBE-expressing backbone vector with BsmBI.
Insert DNA fragments containing gRNA sequences into the linearized backbone vector simultaneously.
Mix gRNA-tBE-expressing backbone vector (U6-ccdB-boxB-tBE-V5-mA3) with DNA fragments containing gRNA sequences, BsmBI (NEB), and T4 DNA Ligase.
Mix 0.5 μl of DNA with reaction components.
Add T4 DNA Ligase Reaction Buffer (10×) to a final volume of 1 μl.
Add H₂O up to a total volume of 10 μl.
Incubate the reaction at 37 ℃ for 5 minutes.
Cycle through 16 ℃ for 10 min and then 37 ℃ for 15 min, repeating 10 times.
Incubate the final mixture at 80 ℃ for 15 minutes.
Transform tBE assembled gRNA vectors into competent cells.
Plate the transformation mixture on a petri dish.
Invert plates and culture at 37 ℃ for 14 hours.
Scrape colonies from plates into a 50 ml tube containing 20 ml LB.
Harvest colonies by centrifugation.
Purify plasmids from transformation colonies using maxi plasmid prep columns according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Seed 293FT cells containing Pgm3-T248C into a 60-mm plate at a density of 4×10⁵ per well and culture for 24 hours.
Transfect cells with plasmids expressing Cas9 and two APOBEC-targeting sgRNAs (sghA3A and sghA3H) using Lipofectamine LTX Reagent, following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Add 10 μg/ml puromycin to the media after 48 hours.
Culture cells with puromycin for two weeks.
Pick up single cell colonies for further analysis.
Seed APOBEC3-knockout cell lines in a 24-well plate at a density of 1×10^5 per well.
Transfect the seeded cells with the plasmid of tBE or other base editor system using LIPOFECTAMINE LTX Reagent.
Add puromycin to the medium after 24 hours at a final concentration of 4 μg/ml.
Pick up single cell colonies after an additional 48 hours.
Extract genomic DNA from edited cells expanded from single colonies using FastPure® DNA isolation Kit.
Seed 293FT^PGM3-T248C cells in a 24-well plate at a density of 1×10^5 per well.
Transfect the seeded cells with the plasmid of tBE or other base editor system using LIPOFECTAMINE LTX Reagent.
Sort cells in the first 15% of fluorescence intensity by FACSAriaIII after 40 hours.
Extract total RNAs from sorted cells using TransZol® Up Plus RNA Kit.
Prepare indexed RNA libraries using TruSeq Stranded Total RNA with Ribo-Zero Globin.
Adjust 1.6×10^11, 8×10^11, or 4×10^12 vg of AAV vectors to 200 μl with sterile PBS.
Inject the adjusted AAV vectors intravenously into 8-week-old female C57BL/6 mice via lateral tail vein injection.
Euthanize the mice two or four weeks after injection by carbon dioxide.
Collect blood from the euthanized mice.
Separate serum from blood by centrifugation.
Measure serum levels of PCSK9 using the Mouse PCSK9 ELISA Kit.
Measure total cholesterol in serum using the Total Cholesterol Kit.
Grind tissues cryogenically into powder.
Isolate genomic DNA from tissue powder using E.Z.N.A.® Tissue DNA Kit.
Isolate total RNA from tissue powder using HiPure Total RNA Plus Mini Kit.
